items.title: ty - Add diagnostic baselines to help adopt ty in projects with existing errors (#27636). Configure a baseline in pyproject.toml: [tool.ty] baseline = "ty-baseline.json" Run ty check --update-baseline to record existing diagnostics. Subsequent checks filter matching diagnostics from CLI output and show them as hints in the language server. The baseline format may change while the feature is in preview.
